summary: Comprehensive frontend-only testing of ADAS educational React app. Verified navbar routing (8 routes), interactive Home hero sensors + info panel, 6 explore cards, 7 path items, ADAS process diagram (5 steps) with detail updates, 7 safety example chips, Sistemi page (8 system cards), System Detail pages (AEB, LKA, ACC — simulation play/stages=4, 3 related links), Sensori page (4 sensor cards + sensor-detail panel), Automazione timeline (6 nodes) with timeline-detail update, Sicurezza scenarios (4) with scenario-answer, Futuro, and a complete 10-question Quiz run (each with explanation + continue), final quiz-result + quiz-retry + quiz-explore. Mobile 390px: hamburger toggle opens nav-mobile-menu. No horizontal overflow at 320px. No console or page errors observed.
critical_code_review_comments: All pages share the same <title> 'ADAS — La sicurezza che vede oltre'. Consider per-route document.title for better SEO/UX.
The /adas process diagram has 5 steps, which is consistent with content, but description could mention actual count in docs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All data-testids present and functional: hero-sensor-*, hero-sensor-panel(+close), explore-card-*, path-*, process-step-*, process-detail, safety-ex-*, system-card-*, sim-play, sim-stage-*, related-*, sensor-card-*, sensor-detail, timeline-node-*, timeline-detail, scenario-*, scenario-answer, quiz-option-*, quiz-explanation, quiz-continue, quiz-result, quiz-retry, quiz-explore, nav-mobile-toggle, nav-mobile-menu. Full E2E quiz (10 Qs) completes to result screen. Mobile hamburger works at 390px, no horizontal scroll at 320px.
